images.title: One side of the grid
images.purpose: Show that the top side of the hollow grid adds to −3, with every other side giving the same −3.
images.composition: One square grid centred with wide margins and the sum written below it.
images.exact_structure: A 3 by 3 grid of 9 equal square cells with the middle cell left empty and drawn as a grey #6B7280 dashed outline. The 3 cells of the top row are filled teal #0072B2 and show 5, −3 and −5 in white. The other 5 cells have grey outlines and no numbers. Exactly 9 cell positions, 3 filled, 1 empty middle.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
numbers written in the 5 other cells
images.takeaway: Adding the three numbers along one side gives −3, and every side gives the same total.
images.description: A 3 by 3 hollow grid with the top row of 5, −3, −5 in teal, which adds to −3.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to add the top row one number at a time, then say what the other sides give.

image_decisions.why: One side of a hollow grid is a picture idea; one clean grid carries it.
